body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Lyon, France. It starts at 796 La Gare.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Le Hameau Duboeuf is Europe's first wine park, boasting over 3,000 objects related to everyone's favorite fermented grape drink! Explore a spectacular collection spanning more than 2,000 years of winemaking history.
>
> Fly over the lush countryside of Beaujolais and the Mâconnais in the 4D cinema, get putting on the mini-golf course, play a game of giant chess, and put the kids on the little train in the garden, all while you indulge in some wine tastings.
>
> It's a di-_wine_ time for everyone!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €29.25. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 50 ratings and 28 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
